title: Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 6

blocks.source_text: It's yet another Tuesday, and it seems that we've officially run out of quippy snapshot intros until the next delivery. Anyway, here's Snapshot 6, bringing some tweaks and improvements to the Abandoned Camp, a new World Options UI, as well as changing up how terrain is rendered.
blocks.translated_text: 又是一个周二，看起来在下次更新之前，我们再也没有幽默的快照介绍了。不管怎样，这是第6个快照（Snapshot 6），它为废弃营地（Abandoned Camp）带来了一些调整和改进，还新增了一个世界选项（World Options）用户界面，并改变了地形的渲染方式。

blocks.source_text: Happy camping!
blocks.translated_text: 祝你们露营愉快！

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 更改（Changes）

blocks.source_text: Added a new Abandoned Camp campsite variant for each biome
blocks.translated_text: 为每个生物群系（biome）添加了一个新的废弃营地（Abandoned Camp）营地类型

blocks.source_text: Minor tweaks to Abandoned Camp structures
blocks.translated_text: 对废弃营地的结构进行了一些小调整

blocks.source_text: UI
blocks.translated_text: 用户界面（UI）

blocks.source_text: Fixed an issue where Realm owners could not select automatic region preference as their Realm region
blocks.translated_text: 修复了一个问题，即领域（Realm）所有者无法将自动区域偏好设置为自己领域的区域（region）

blocks.source_text: World Options
blocks.translated_text: 世界选项（World Options）

blocks.source_text: The World Options button has been moved to where the Open to Lan button used to be, accessible from the pause menu
blocks.translated_text: 世界选项按钮已被移到原来的“开启局域网模式”（Open to Lan）按钮的位置，现在可以从暂停菜单（pause menu）访问它

blocks.source_text: The World Options screen is divided into two sections: "General" and "Multiplayer"
blocks.translated_text: 世界选项屏幕分为两个部分：“常规”（General）和“多人游戏”（Multiplayer）

blocks.source_text: The "General" section contains the same options as the previous World Options screen
blocks.translated_text: 「常规」选项卡包含与上一个世界设置界面相同的选项

blocks.source_text: The "Multiplayer" section contains three options:
blocks.translated_text: 「多人游戏」选项卡包含三个选项

blocks.source_text: LAN: changes the multiplayer scope of the world
blocks.translated_text: 局域网（LAN）：用于更改世界的多人游戏模式

blocks.source_text: Command Access: Controls whether players that join your world can use commands or not
blocks.translated_text: 命令访问权限：控制加入你世界的玩家是否可以使用命令

blocks.source_text: Port: the port number to use when opening the world to LAN
blocks.translated_text: 端口：用于通过局域网打开世界的端口号

blocks.source_text: The Online button used to access the Online Options screen will now always be shown in the Options menu
blocks.translated_text: 「在线」按钮现在将始终显示在设置菜单中，用于访问在线设置界面

blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本现已更新至113.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 94.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本现已更新至94.0

blocks.source_text: Terrain blocks are now rendered with MultiDrawIndirect on supported devices
blocks.translated_text: 在支持的设备上，地形块现在使用MultiDrawIndirect进行渲染

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 113.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本 113.0

blocks.translated_text: 命令

blocks.translated_text: 发布功能的更改

blocks.translated_text: 移除了 `gamemode` 参数

blocks.source_text: Instead, the default game mode of the world should be set using the defaultgamemode command or the Game Mode button in the World Options screen, while player-specific game modes should be set using the gamemode command
blocks.translated_text: 现在应该使用 `defaultgamemode` 命令或世界设置界面中的“游戏模式”按钮来设置世界的默认游戏模式；而针对玩家的游戏模式则需要使用 `gamemode` 命令来设置

blocks.translated_text: 更改了 `minecraft:cooking_fuel` 属性

blocks.source_text: uses and speed_multiplier can now additionally be defined by an inline number

blocks.source_text: World Generation
blocks.translated_text: 世界生成机制

blocks.source_text: Noises
blocks.translated_text: 音效系统

blocks.source_text: The format of Noises (defined in the worldgen/noise registry, or inline in noise-based Block State Providers) has been updated.
blocks.translated_text: 音效的格式已更新（在 `worldgen/noise` 注册表中定义，或通过基于音效的块状态提供程序内联设置）

blocks.source_text: Noises define a fractal Brownian motion (fBm) configuration with the following properties:
blocks.translated_text: 噪声定义了一个具有以下特性的分形布朗运动（fBm）配置：

blocks.source_text: Produces output values (approximately) fitting a normal distribution
blocks.translated_text: 生成大致符合正态分布的输出值

blocks.source_text: Unless otherwise specified, fits the output amplitude to [-1; 1]
blocks.translated_text: 除非另有说明，否则输出振幅将限制在 [-1; 1] 范围内

blocks.source_text: Due to the normal distribution, in practice this means that 99.7% of all samples will fit in that range - but values may still be encountered outside of this range
blocks.translated_text: 由于遵循正态分布，实际上 99.7% 的样本都会落在该范围内——但仍然有可能出现超出此范围的值

blocks.source_text: Parameterized by persistence=0.5, lacunarity=2.0
blocks.translated_text: 该算法通过参数 persistence=0.5 和 lacunarity=2.0 来控制其行为

blocks.source_text: i.e. between each octave, the amplitude is halved and the frequency doubled
blocks.translated_text: 具体来说，每个八度音程的振幅减半，频率加倍

blocks.source_text: Has stable seeding such that an octave can be boosted, muted, or added without affecting the rest of the octaves
blocks.translated_text: 具有稳定的种子值，因此可以单独调整某个八度音程的音量，而不影响其他音程

blocks.source_text: Renamed firstOctave to base_octave
blocks.translated_text: 将 firstOctave 重命名为 base_octave

blocks.source_text: Added base_amplitude - non-negative float, a scale factor to apply to the noise output
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 base_amplitude 参数，这是一个用于调整噪声输出的比例因子（非负浮点数）

blocks.source_text: If not specified, defaults to 1.0
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认值为 1.0

blocks.source_text: Added octave_count - integer between 1 and 32, the number of octaves to sample
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 `octave_count` 参数——一个介于 1 和 32 之间的整数，表示要采样的八度数

blocks.source_text: Added normalize - boolean, or "legacy", controls how the output amplitude should be normalized
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 `normalize` 参数（布尔值，默认为 `legacy`），用于控制输出幅度的归一化方式

blocks.source_text: If true , base_amplitude is the expected amplitude of the output (i.e. 99.7% of all samples in [-base_amplitude; base_amplitude] )
blocks.translated_text: 如果设置为 `true`，`base_amplitude` 即为预期的输出幅度（即所有样本的 99.7% 都在 `[-base_amplitude; base_amplitude]` 范围内

blocks.source_text: If false , base_amplitude is the amplitude of the first octave
blocks.translated_text: 如果设置为 `false`，`base_amplitude` 即为第一个八度的幅度

blocks.source_text: If "legacy" , inherits the same normalization behavior as expressed by the previous format
blocks.translated_text: 如果设置为 `legacy`，则继承之前格式的归一化行为

blocks.source_text: This would generally fit to a range smaller than expected
blocks.translated_text: 该参数通常适用于比预期更小的范围

blocks.source_text: If not specified, defaults to true
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认值为 `true`

blocks.source_text: Note: normalization is *not* affected by the amplitude_modifiers field - as such, modifying the amplitude of a single octave will not affect the amplitude of others
blocks.translated_text: 注意：归一化行为*不受* `amplitude_modifiers` 参数的影响——因此，修改某个八度的幅度不会影响其他八度的幅度

blocks.source_text: Renamed amplitudes to amplitude_modifiers - list of floats, a scaling factor to apply to each octave
blocks.translated_text: 将“amplitudes”更名为“amplitude_modifiers”——一个包含浮点数的列表，用于对每个八度段应用缩放因子

blocks.source_text: The number of elements in this list must match octave_count
blocks.translated_text: 此列表中的元素数量必须与“octave_count”相匹配

blocks.source_text: As described above, this scaling factor bypasses normalization and will affect the output amplitude
blocks.translated_text: 如上所述，该缩放因子会绕过标准化处理，从而影响输出振幅

blocks.source_text: This field is no longer required - if not specified, defaults to all 1.0
blocks.translated_text: 此字段不再是必需的；如果未指定，默认值为1.0

blocks.source_text: distance_to_point
blocks.translated_text: 距离到点的计算

blocks.source_text: Computes the distance to a fixed point using the specified distance function.
blocks.translated_text: 使用指定的距离函数计算到固定点的距离

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含以下字段的对象：

blocks.source_text: point - array of 3 integers in form [x, y, z] , the point to compute distance to
blocks.translated_text: point - 一个形式为 [x, y, z] 的整数数组，表示要计算距离的点

blocks.source_text: metric - one of:
blocks.translated_text: metric - 可选的距离计算方式之一：

blocks.source_text: euclidean - i.e. sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2)
blocks.translated_text: 欧几里得距离 - 即 sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2)

blocks.source_text: euclidean_squared - i.e. dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2
blocks.translated_text: 欧几里得平方距离 - 即 dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2

blocks.source_text: manhattan - i.e. abs(dx) + abs(dy) + abs(dz)
blocks.translated_text: 曼哈顿距离 - 即 abs(dx) + abs(dy) + abs(dz)

blocks.source_text: chebyshev - i.e. max(abs(dx), abs(dy), abs(dz))
blocks.translated_text: 切比雪夫距离 - 即 max(abs(dx), abs(dy), abs(dz)

blocks.source_text: gradient
blocks.translated_text: 渐变

blocks.source_text: (renamed from
blocks.translated_text: (从...重命名)

blocks.source_text: y_clamped_gradient
blocks.translated_text: y方向限定渐变

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：带有字段的对象

blocks.source_text: axis - x , y , or z , the axis over which to define this gradient
blocks.translated_text: 轴 - x、y或z轴，用于定义该渐变的轴

blocks.source_text: tiling - one of:
blocks.translated_text: 平铺方式 - 有以下几种：

blocks.source_text: clamp_to_edge - outside the gradient boundaries, the value at the nearest boundary will be used
blocks.translated_text: 限制在边缘内 - 如果值超出渐变范围，将使用最接近边缘的值

blocks.source_text: repeat - the gradient will be repeated outside its boundaries
blocks.translated_text: 重复 - 渐变将在其范围外重复显示

blocks.source_text: mirrored_repeat - the gradient will be repeated such that odd repetitions are mirrored, ensuring continuity between repetitions
blocks.translated_text: 镜像重复 - 渐变将以这样的方式重复：奇数次重复会进行镜像处理，以确保重复部分之间的连续性

blocks.source_text: from_coordinate - int, the coordinate at which the gradient starts
blocks.translated_text: from_coordinate - 整数，渐变开始的坐标

blocks.source_text: to_coordinate - int, the coordinate at which the gradient ends
blocks.translated_text: to.coordinate - 整数，渐变结束的坐标

blocks.source_text: Must not be equal to from_coordinate
blocks.translated_text: 不得等于 from.coordinate

blocks.source_text: from_value - float, the value at which the gradient starts
blocks.translated_text: from_value - 浮点数，渐变开始的值

blocks.source_text: to_value - float, the value at which the gradient ends
blocks.translated_text: to_value - 浮点数，渐变结束的值

blocks.translated_text: 已添加

blocks.source_text: slice
blocks.translated_text: 切片

blocks.source_text: Removes a dimension from the input domain by taking a "slice" along an axis with a specific coordinate. For example, with axis=y and coordinate=0, a slice will be taken along the XZ plane, with all values sampled at y=0.
blocks.translated_text: 通过沿特定坐标所在的轴进行“切片”操作，从输入数据域中移除一个维度。例如，当轴为 y 且坐标为 0 时，将沿 XZ 平面进行切片，取出所有 y=0 处的值

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含字段的对象

blocks.source_text: axis - x , y , or z , the axis to remove
blocks.translated_text: axis - x、y 或 z，要移除的轴

blocks.source_text: coordinate - int, the fixed coordinate to be passed to the input function
blocks.translated_text: coordinate - int, 要传递给输入函数的固定坐标

blocks.source_text: input - Density Function, the input function
blocks.translated_text: input - Density Function, 输入函数

blocks.translated_text: 结构池元素

blocks.translated_text: 已更改

blocks.translated_text: minecraft:feature_pool_element

blocks.translated_text: 现在可以连接到任何目标名称的拼图方块，而不仅仅是 minecraft:bottom

blocks.source_text: Shaders & Post-process Effects
blocks.translated_text: 着色器与后期处理效果

blocks.source_text: terrain.vsh and terrain.fsh shaders are refactored to support multi-draw
blocks.translated_text: terrain.vsh 和 terrain.fsh 着色器经过重构，以支持多次绘制

blocks.source_text: Some of the members in Globals and DynamicTransforms are shuffled to use less memory for those uniform blocks
blocks.translated_text: 调整了 Globals 和 DynamicTransforms 中的一些成员，以减少用于这些uniform块的内存使用

blocks.source_text: Introduced new define: RENDERPEARL_EXPLICIT_DEPTH_INVARIANCE - If present, indicates that an OIT shader should explicitly output a depth value because a device it is running on can produce a slightly different implicit value
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 define：RENDERPEARL_EXPLICIT_DEPTH_INVARIANCE——如果存在该定义，表示OIT着色器应显式输出深度值，因为运行它的设备可能会产生略有不同的隐式深度值

blocks.source_text: Equipment Assets
blocks.translated_text: 装备资产

blocks.source_text: The trim_palette_replacements field has been replaced with trim_overrides. This can be used to swap out the texture or palette used with specific trim materials or patterns for a given equipment asset, not just swap specific palettes.
blocks.translated_text: trim_palette_replacements 字段已被 trim_overrides 替代。现在可以使用 trim_overrides 来替换特定装备资产使用的纹理或调色板，而不仅仅是特定的调色板

blocks.source_text: Format: list of override entries with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含字段的Override条目列表

blocks.source_text: when - object with fields, the material and/or pattern to match
blocks.translated_text: 当使用具有字段的对象时，需要指定要匹配的材料和/或图案

blocks.source_text: material - optional Trim Material ID, the material to match (if specified)
blocks.translated_text: material - 可选：裁剪材料ID，需要匹配的材料（如果指定了的话）

blocks.source_text: pattern - optional Trim Pattern ID, the pattern to match (if specified)
blocks.translated_text: pattern - 可选：裁剪图案ID，需要匹配的图案（如果指定了的话）

blocks.source_text: Note: this is *not* the palette ID, as trim_palette_replacements used to be!
blocks.translated_text: 注意：这*不是*调色板ID，因为以前的 `trim_palette_replacements` 是这样的！

blocks.source_text: At least one of material or pattern must be specified
blocks.translated_text: 必须指定材料或图案中的一个

blocks.source_text: If both are specified, both must match for the entry to be used
blocks.translated_text: 如果同时指定了两者，那么这两个都必须匹配才能使用该条目

blocks.source_text: texture - optional trim pattern asset ID, a replacement texture to use if this entry matches
blocks.translated_text: texture - 可选：裁剪图案资产ID，如果该条目匹配，则使用此替换纹理

blocks.source_text: Textures are specified in the same format as asset_id
blocks.translated_text: 纹理的格式与 `asset_id` 相同

blocks.source_text: If not specified, the default texture for the pattern will be used
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，则将使用该图案的默认纹理

blocks.source_text: palette - optional palette ID, a replacement palette to use if this entry matches
blocks.translated_text: palette - 可选：调色板ID，如果该条目匹配，则使用此替换调色板

blocks.source_text: If not specified, no palette remapping will be applied to the texture
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，则不会对纹理进行调色板重映射

blocks.source_text: The first matching entry will always be selected
blocks.translated_text: 系统总会选择第一个匹配的条目

blocks.source_text: At least one of texture or palette must be defined
blocks.translated_text: 必须定义纹理（texture）或调色板（palette）中的至少一个

It's yet another Tuesday, and it seems that we've officially run out of quippy snapshot intros until the next delivery. Anyway, here's Snapshot 6, bringing some tweaks and improvements to the Abandoned Camp, a new World Options UI, as well as changing up how terrain is rendered.

Happy camping!

Changes

Added a new Abandoned Camp campsite variant for each biome

Minor tweaks to Abandoned Camp structures

UI

Fixed an issue where Realm owners could not select automatic region preference as their Realm region

World Options

The World Options button has been moved to where the Open to Lan button used to be, accessible from the pause menu

The World Options screen is divided into two sections: "General" and "Multiplayer"

The "General" section contains the same options as the previous World Options screen

The "Multiplayer" section contains three options:

LAN: changes the multiplayer scope of the world

Command Access: Controls whether players that join your world can use commands or not

Port: the port number to use when opening the world to LAN

The Online button used to access the Online Options screen will now always be shown in the Options menu

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 113.0

The Resource Pack version is now 94.0

Terrain blocks are now rendered with MultiDrawIndirect on supported devices

Data Pack Version 113.0

Commands

Changes to publish

The gamemode argument has been removed

Instead, the default game mode of the world should be set using the defaultgamemode command or the Game Mode button in the World Options screen, while player-specific game modes should be set using the gamemode command

Data Components

Changed minecraft:cooking_fuel

burn_time and speed_multiplier can now additionally be defined by an inline number

Changed minecraft:brewing_fuel

uses and speed_multiplier can now additionally be defined by an inline number

Changed minecraft:compostable

layers can now additionally be defined by an inline number

Entity Data

Added invulnerable_time tag which makes a mob temporarily invulnerable for a specific number of ticks

Loot Table Types

Changed minecraft:block_interact

origin is now available in context, as the center of the block being interacted with

World Generation

Noises

The format of Noises (defined in the worldgen/noise registry, or inline in noise-based Block State Providers) has been updated.

Noises define a fractal Brownian motion (fBm) configuration with the following properties:

Produces output values (approximately) fitting a normal distribution

Unless otherwise specified, fits the output amplitude to [-1; 1]

Due to the normal distribution, in practice this means that 99.7% of all samples will fit in that range - but values may still be encountered outside of this range

Parameterized by persistence=0.5, lacunarity=2.0

i.e. between each octave, the amplitude is halved and the frequency doubled

Has stable seeding such that an octave can be boosted, muted, or added without affecting the rest of the octaves

Renamed firstOctave to base_octave

Added base_amplitude - non-negative float, a scale factor to apply to the noise output

If not specified, defaults to 1.0

Added octave_count - integer between 1 and 32, the number of octaves to sample

Added normalize - boolean, or "legacy", controls how the output amplitude should be normalized

If true , base_amplitude is the expected amplitude of the output (i.e. 99.7% of all samples in [-base_amplitude; base_amplitude] )

If false , base_amplitude is the amplitude of the first octave

If "legacy" , inherits the same normalization behavior as expressed by the previous format

This would generally fit to a range smaller than expected

If not specified, defaults to true

Note: normalization is *not* affected by the amplitude_modifiers field - as such, modifying the amplitude of a single octave will not affect the amplitude of others

Renamed amplitudes to amplitude_modifiers - list of floats, a scaling factor to apply to each octave

The number of elements in this list must match octave_count

As described above, this scaling factor bypasses normalization and will affect the output amplitude

This field is no longer required - if not specified, defaults to all 1.0

Density Functions

Added

pow

Raises the given base value to an exponent.

Format: object with fields:

base - Density Function, the base value

exponent - Density Function, the exponent

Added

sqrt

Computes the square root of the given input.

Format: object with fields:

input - Density Function, the value for which to compute the square root

Added

log

Computes the natural logarithm of the given input.

Format: object with fields:

input - Density Function, the value for which to compute the natural logarithm

Added

sign

Computes the sign of the input:

If the input is positive, returns 1

If the input is 0 , returns 0

If input is negative, returns -1

Format: object with fields:

input - Density Function, the value of which to compute the sign

Added

distance_to_point

Computes the distance to a fixed point using the specified distance function.

Format: object with fields:

point - array of 3 integers in form [x, y, z] , the point to compute distance to

metric - one of:

euclidean - i.e. sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2)

euclidean_squared - i.e. dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2

manhattan - i.e. abs(dx) + abs(dy) + abs(dz)

chebyshev - i.e. max(abs(dx), abs(dy), abs(dz))

Updated

gradient

(renamed from

y_clamped_gradient

)

Format: object with fields:

axis - x , y , or z , the axis over which to define this gradient

tiling - one of:

clamp_to_edge - outside the gradient boundaries, the value at the nearest boundary will be used

repeat - the gradient will be repeated outside its boundaries

mirrored_repeat - the gradient will be repeated such that odd repetitions are mirrored, ensuring continuity between repetitions

from_coordinate - int, the coordinate at which the gradient starts

to_coordinate - int, the coordinate at which the gradient ends

Must not be equal to from_coordinate

from_value - float, the value at which the gradient starts

to_value - float, the value at which the gradient ends

Added

slice

Removes a dimension from the input domain by taking a "slice" along an axis with a specific coordinate. For example, with axis=y and coordinate=0, a slice will be taken along the XZ plane, with all values sampled at y=0.

Format: object with fields:

axis - x , y , or z , the axis to remove

coordinate - int, the fixed coordinate to be passed to the input function

input - Density Function, the input function

Changed

end_outer_islands

Renamed from end_islands. No longer computes the density of the main island.

Structure Pool Elements

Changed

minecraft:feature_pool_element

Can now connect to Jigsaw blocks with any target name, instead of just minecraft:bottom

Resource Pack Version 94.0

Shaders & Post-process Effects

terrain.vsh and terrain.fsh shaders are refactored to support multi-draw

Some of the members in Globals and DynamicTransforms are shuffled to use less memory for those uniform blocks

Introduced new define: RENDERPEARL_EXPLICIT_DEPTH_INVARIANCE - If present, indicates that an OIT shader should explicitly output a depth value because a device it is running on can produce a slightly different implicit value

Equipment Assets

The trim_palette_replacements field has been replaced with trim_overrides. This can be used to swap out the texture or palette used with specific trim materials or patterns for a given equipment asset, not just swap specific palettes.

Format: list of override entries with fields:

when - object with fields, the material and/or pattern to match

material - optional Trim Material ID, the material to match (if specified)

pattern - optional Trim Pattern ID, the pattern to match (if specified)

Note: this is *not* the palette ID, as trim_palette_replacements used to be!

At least one of material or pattern must be specified

If both are specified, both must match for the entry to be used

texture - optional trim pattern asset ID, a replacement texture to use if this entry matches

Textures are specified in the same format as asset_id

If not specified, the default texture for the pattern will be used

palette - optional palette ID, a replacement palette to use if this entry matches

If not specified, no palette remapping will be applied to the texture

The first matching entry will always be selected

At least one of texture or palette must be defined

又是一个周二，看起来在下次更新之前，我们再也没有幽默的快照介绍了。不管怎样，这是第6个快照（Snapshot 6），它为废弃营地（Abandoned Camp）带来了一些调整和改进，还新增了一个世界选项（World Options）用户界面，并改变了地形的渲染方式。

祝你们露营愉快！

更改（Changes）

为每个生物群系（biome）添加了一个新的废弃营地（Abandoned Camp）营地类型

对废弃营地的结构进行了一些小调整

用户界面（UI）

修复了一个问题，即领域（Realm）所有者无法将自动区域偏好设置为自己领域的区域（region）

世界选项（World Options）

世界选项按钮已被移到原来的“开启局域网模式”（Open to Lan）按钮的位置，现在可以从暂停菜单（pause menu）访问它

世界选项屏幕分为两个部分：“常规”（General）和“多人游戏”（Multiplayer）

「常规」选项卡包含与上一个世界设置界面相同的选项

「多人游戏」选项卡包含三个选项

局域网（LAN）：用于更改世界的多人游戏模式

命令访问权限：控制加入你世界的玩家是否可以使用命令

端口：用于通过局域网打开世界的端口号

「在线」按钮现在将始终显示在设置菜单中，用于访问在线设置界面

技术性变更

数据包的版本现已更新至113.0

资源包的版本现已更新至94.0

在支持的设备上，地形块现在使用MultiDrawIndirect进行渲染

数据包版本 113.0

命令

发布功能的更改

移除了 `gamemode` 参数

现在应该使用 `defaultgamemode` 命令或世界设置界面中的“游戏模式”按钮来设置世界的默认游戏模式；而针对玩家的游戏模式则需要使用 `gamemode` 命令来设置

数据组件

更改了 `minecraft:cooking_fuel` 属性

现在可以通过内联数字来额外定义 `burn_time`（燃烧时间）和 `speed_multiplier`（燃烧速度倍数）

更改了 `minecraft:brewing_fuel` 属性

现在可以通过内联数字来额外定义 `uses`（使用频率）和 `speed_multiplier`（使用速度倍数）

修改了 `minecraft:compostable` 的定义

现在可以通过内联数字来定义图层

实体数据RESPONSIBILITY}

新增了 `invulnerable_time` 标签，可使怪物在特定数量的刻(tick)内暂时免疫伤害

战利品表类型

修改了 `minecraft:block_interact` 的功能

现在可以通过上下文获取“origin”值，即被交互图块的中心位置

世界生成机制

音效系统

音效的格式已更新（在 `worldgen/noise` 注册表中定义，或通过基于音效的块状态提供程序内联设置）

噪声定义了一个具有以下特性的分形布朗运动（fBm）配置：

生成大致符合正态分布的输出值

除非另有说明，否则输出振幅将限制在 [-1; 1] 范围内

由于遵循正态分布，实际上 99.7% 的样本都会落在该范围内——但仍然有可能出现超出此范围的值

该算法通过参数 persistence=0.5 和 lacunarity=2.0 来控制其行为

具体来说，每个八度音程的振幅减半，频率加倍

具有稳定的种子值，因此可以单独调整某个八度音程的音量，而不影响其他音程

将 firstOctave 重命名为 base_octave

新增了 base_amplitude 参数，这是一个用于调整噪声输出的比例因子（非负浮点数）

如果未指定，默认值为 1.0

新增了 `octave_count` 参数——一个介于 1 和 32 之间的整数，表示要采样的八度数

新增了 `normalize` 参数（布尔值，默认为 `legacy`），用于控制输出幅度的归一化方式

如果设置为 `true`，`base_amplitude` 即为预期的输出幅度（即所有样本的 99.7% 都在 `[-base_amplitude; base_amplitude]` 范围内

如果设置为 `false`，`base_amplitude` 即为第一个八度的幅度

如果设置为 `legacy`，则继承之前格式的归一化行为

该参数通常适用于比预期更小的范围

如果未指定，默认值为 `true`

注意：归一化行为*不受* `amplitude_modifiers` 参数的影响——因此，修改某个八度的幅度不会影响其他八度的幅度

将“amplitudes”更名为“amplitude_modifiers”——一个包含浮点数的列表，用于对每个八度段应用缩放因子

此列表中的元素数量必须与“octave_count”相匹配

如上所述，该缩放因子会绕过标准化处理，从而影响输出振幅

此字段不再是必需的；如果未指定，默认值为1.0

密度函数（Density Functions）

已添加（Added）

pow（幂运算函数）

将给定的基数提升到指定的指数

格式要求：使用包含字段的对象（Format: object with fields:）

base（基数）——密度函数的基数值

指数 - 密度函数，即指数参数

已添加

平方根

计算给定值的平方根

格式：带字段的对象

输入参数 - 需要计算平方根的数值

已添加

对数

计算给定值的自然对数

格式：带字段的对象

输入 - 密度函数，用于计算自然对数的值

已添加

sign

计算输入的符号：

如果输入为正数，返回 1

如果输入为 0，返回 0

如果输入为负数，返回 -1

格式：包含字段的对象

输入 - 用于计算符号的密度函数值

已添加

距离到点的计算

使用指定的距离函数计算到固定点的距离

格式：包含以下字段的对象：

point - 一个形式为 [x, y, z] 的整数数组，表示要计算距离的点

metric - 可选的距离计算方式之一：

欧几里得距离 - 即 sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2)

欧几里得平方距离 - 即 dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2

曼哈顿距离 - 即 abs(dx) + abs(dy) + abs(dz)

切比雪夫距离 - 即 max(abs(dx), abs(dy), abs(dz)

已更新

渐变

(从...重命名)

y方向限定渐变

格式：带有字段的对象

轴 - x、y或z轴，用于定义该渐变的轴

平铺方式 - 有以下几种：

限制在边缘内 - 如果值超出渐变范围，将使用最接近边缘的值

重复 - 渐变将在其范围外重复显示

镜像重复 - 渐变将以这样的方式重复：奇数次重复会进行镜像处理，以确保重复部分之间的连续性

from_coordinate - 整数，渐变开始的坐标

to.coordinate - 整数，渐变结束的坐标

不得等于 from.coordinate

from_value - 浮点数，渐变开始的值

to_value - 浮点数，渐变结束的值

已添加

切片

通过沿特定坐标所在的轴进行“切片”操作，从输入数据域中移除一个维度。例如，当轴为 y 且坐标为 0 时，将沿 XZ 平面进行切片，取出所有 y=0 处的值

格式：包含字段的对象

axis - x、y 或 z，要移除的轴

coordinate - int, 要传递给输入函数的固定坐标

input - Density Function, 输入函数

已更改

end_outer_islands

从 end_islands 重命名。不再计算主岛的密度。

结构池元素

已更改

minecraft:feature_pool_element

现在可以连接到任何目标名称的拼图方块，而不仅仅是 minecraft:bottom

资源包版本 94.0

着色器与后期处理效果

terrain.vsh 和 terrain.fsh 着色器经过重构，以支持多次绘制

调整了 Globals 和 DynamicTransforms 中的一些成员，以减少用于这些uniform块的内存使用

新增了 define：RENDERPEARL_EXPLICIT_DEPTH_INVARIANCE——如果存在该定义，表示OIT着色器应显式输出深度值，因为运行它的设备可能会产生略有不同的隐式深度值

装备资产

trim_palette_replacements 字段已被 trim_overrides 替代。现在可以使用 trim_overrides 来替换特定装备资产使用的纹理或调色板，而不仅仅是特定的调色板

格式：包含字段的Override条目列表

当使用具有字段的对象时，需要指定要匹配的材料和/或图案

material - 可选：裁剪材料ID，需要匹配的材料（如果指定了的话）

pattern - 可选：裁剪图案ID，需要匹配的图案（如果指定了的话）

注意：这*不是*调色板ID，因为以前的 `trim_palette_replacements` 是这样的！

必须指定材料或图案中的一个

如果同时指定了两者，那么这两个都必须匹配才能使用该条目

texture - 可选：裁剪图案资产ID，如果该条目匹配，则使用此替换纹理

纹理的格式与 `asset_id` 相同

如果未指定，则将使用该图案的默认纹理

palette - 可选：调色板ID，如果该条目匹配，则使用此替换调色板

如果未指定，则不会对纹理进行调色板重映射

系统总会选择第一个匹配的条目

必须定义纹理（texture）或调色板（palette）中的至少一个
